title: office.scribe-control request
description: Read or change one session's scribe control record in Office plugin state. get, request_now and heartbeat take only op and session_id; set_switch takes on and, on a turn-on, optional on_by and scope; set_title takes title; consume_now takes an optional requested_at (clears the pending Capture-now request only if it is still that request). A turn-on under Orbit managed-task context is refused (scribe_managed_session).

on.description: set_switch only: the new switch state.

on_by.description: set_switch turn-on only: who turned scribing on (the user, or an orchestrator agent in an interactive session).

scope.description: set_switch turn-on only: the session scope token the turn-on named.

title.description: set_title only: a single-line user title.

requested_at.description: consume_now only: the now_requested_at value read earlier; omit to clear any pending request.
